I bought the Uppercase Bullet Medium (66 cm) trolley bag in Silver and I am very happy with the purchase. The hard shell body feels very strong and durable, and the anti-scratch finish keeps it looking new even after rough handling at airports.The best part is the inside compartments. There are separate sections for wet clothes and undergarments, which is very useful for short trips. Packing becomes very easy and organized. The space is more than enough for 4–5 days travel.The wheels are super smooth and rotate 360°, so moving the bag is effortless even in crowded railway stations and airports. TSA lock and anti-theft zipper add extra security which gives peace of mind.It looks premium, is lightweight, and very practical. Overall, excellent quality and value for money. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a stylish and strong trolley bag in this price range.

I recently purchased these Trolley Bag, and I must say, I'm impressed. The durability of the eco-polycarbonate shell is outstanding, along with its antiscratch body which is very rare to find in any other brand. The interior compartments are well-designed, helping me stay organized.And small and medium compartment inside bag for wet clothes and under garments are one of its kind.I haven’t seen such feature in other trolley bag due to which it provide flexibility for short trips.The trolley wheels glide smoothly, making it easy to maneuver through airports and crowded streets. The colour is pleasant and soothing.Overall, this trolley bag has proven to be a great with innovative design for my travel needs. Also the antitheft zip is an addon to many of the unique features.Overall i am fully satisfied with my choice of product.!!!!

The Uppercase Bullet (Medium) 66cm Check-in Trolley Bag is a travel essential that adds flair to your journey. The silver color is not only eye-catching but also stands out in a sea of mundane luggage.The spacious interior and clever compartment design make packing a breeze. The 8-wheel functionality ensures smooth navigation through bustling airports. The TSA lock and anti-theft zippers provide an added layer of security, which is reassuring for any traveler.However, I did notice that the build quality isn't top-tier. While the suitcase is sturdy, there are minor quality quirks that might affect its long-term durability. Nevertheless, the 2000 days warranty is a comforting assurance.In conclusion, the Uppercase Bullet is a stylish and functional check-in trolley bag, with a pop of silver to distinguish it. Just be mindful of the build quality nuances. Travel in style with a touch of practicality! 🧳✈️

While the design and outer suitcase is nice and as advertised, the interior is hopeless. The zipper quality is extremely poor - that which is used on products sold by very cheap street vendors. If you do not use the suitcase for a few months, these zippers become brittle and break upon touch. The yellow foam lining the interiors is stuck using glue and came out upon first use. It seems like the company really cut corners where they could so they could only deliver on what they marketed - design and shell strength. Disappointing and not recommended if you're looking for a quality product that you can actually use for a while.
